sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Research Queries (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official RRC Research Queries directory supplies the separately named Completions Query route, nightly update label, and global online-query disclaimer.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the directory only to preserve the official entry route, source identity, update label, and limitation; it does not treat a result as authoritative, legally effective, complete, connected to private property, or sufficient for a downstream conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Oil and Gas Completions Home (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official Oil & Gas Completions home separates Completions Query, Completions Package, Directional Survey Query, and reports, and displays its online-packet coverage statement.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only to preserve the route, displayed navigation, source-stated packet coverage, and separate production-data update statement without deciding a well, packet, production, regulatory, or property fact.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Completions Query Search (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official Completions Query search displays the all-selected-criteria behavior and current search labels for one retrieval attempt.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article records only criteria actually used, source-displayed instructions, navigation that occurred, and bounded retrieval state. It does not submit or reproduce an actual property-specific result.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Oil and Gas Imaged Records Query Menu (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official Imaged Records menu supplies separate well-record and historical-channel context plus its own completion-packet filing statement.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article preserves that separate route and source wording without reconciling it into a property, well, filing, completion, or legal conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Well Records FAQs (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official Well Records FAQs describe the Completion Query route and categories of records that can appear in Oil & Gas Well Records.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the FAQ only to distinguish retrieval channels and preserve source wording; it does not infer that a named record exists, is complete, applies to a property, or proves a downstream fact.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Data Sets Available for Download (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official download page separately lists Completion Information in Data Format and Imaged Completion Files with current source-displayed update labels.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only to separate bulk-download provenance from the public query and does not treat a download as equivalent to a query result or as interpreted evidence.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Website Queries training slides (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official RRC training slide deck supplies agency-authored website-query navigation context.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article retains the deck only as bounded navigation context and does not use it to establish a current requirement, packet interpretation, compliance conclusion, property connection, or transaction decision.
